changes.title: Recorded death context uses exact public history
changes.text: A bounded read-only model joins one exact case-sensitive Deaths row to already recorded public observations for 1-1000 final turns. It distinguishes revived, final, non-final and unknown outcomes, preserves missing data, and explicitly does not infer survival, causation or absent events.

changes.title: Deaths rows open native final-turn evidence
changes.text: Individual Deaths rows gain a Death context action with 5, 10, 25, 50 and 100 turn choices plus validated 1-1000 custom input. The API34 gate uses a persisted binary run to open explicit revived and final deaths through real pointer actions, checks caveats and restoration, captures the new screen and proves raw history unchanged.
